content.rendered:

Appearance of players have been improved, as you can see Messi, Christiano Ronaldo, Pjanic, Salah, Lukaku and many other players have there real faces in the game.

Background music is still present in 2021 PES Lite Iso Save Data Textures, as this will keep you entertained while navigating round the game Menu such as Match, MLS, Champions League, Edit, Gallery etc.

Master League in PES Lite 21 eFootball PPSSPP also works, to get the best experience you might consider downloading the full PES 2021 PSP Iso Save Data Textures in which the size is more than the Lite Edition.

If you want to increase the strength, stamina, Agility of your players in the menu of PES 2021 Lite, you can click Edit in the main Menu of PES 21 Lite.

How To Install PES 2021 Lite Iso Save Data Textures

To install PES 21 Lite Iso Save Data Textures is very easy if you take your time to follow the steps below.

Steps to Install PES Lite 2021 Iso Save Data Textures are:

  1. Using or open Zarchiver App file manager.
  2. Locate PES 21 Lite Iso Save Data Textures Rar file.
  3. Click on it, options menu will come up.
  4. Click Extract from the options menu.
  5. Immediately navigate or go to Device Memory or Internal Memory and wait.
  6. Click Extract Icon which looks like a arrow pointing downwards.
  7. PES 21 Lite rar file will be extracted completely after reaching 100%.
  8. PES Lite Iso Textures Save Data files can now be found in PSP folder, because the file above was compiled for the files to automatically go into the PSP folder.
  9. To play the PES Lite 21 PPSSPP emulator game, open the Emulator app and click on the iso file icon by locating it in PSP folder.
